artifact_types: session script with entry mode, question sequence and progress labels
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
hard_gates: Developer experience claims require a real target-bound journey with recorded environment, commands, elapsed time, errors, recovery, and cleanup; reading docs alone is insufficient.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
A facilitator may structure and record the decision but must not manufacture consensus or decide for the named owner.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
One task has one writer and one isolated workspace; missing isolation, dirty-state ambiguity, concurrent ownership, or scope expansion blocks implementation.
A candidate Skill must have one atomic responsibility, exact provenance, tested trigger boundaries, least authority, and no release claim; multi-stage orchestration belongs to a Recipe.
inputs: Repository, runnable setup path, common tasks, errors, timings, and contributor context.
A multi-role task, incomplete context, stakeholder set, and decision boundary.
One approved task, complete task-local context, isolated workspace, edit scope, test command, and escalation boundary.
Capability contract, source evidence, runtime target, fixtures, tests, and package boundary.
outputs: session script with entry mode, question sequence and progress labels
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 4 related modes: Execute an authorized developer journey and measure time-to-first-success, setup, errors, documentation, compatibility, and recovery without changing product source.; Design a bounded collaborative session that elicits evidence, preserves dissent, records decisions, and assigns follow-up authority.; Implement one frozen task in one isolated authorized workspace with a single writer, bounded checks, and a reviewable handoff.; Author and locally validate one atomic workflow Skill from an approved capability contract, provenance, fixtures, trigger policy, and package boundary.
